observation_summary: A ClassCastException occurs when the application attempts to process fields with generic type definitions.
reasoning_summary: The stack trace consistently points to a ClassCastException occurring in GenericMaster.getGenericType. This indicates that the code assumes the result of a reflection operation (likely field.getGenericType()) will always be an instance of java.lang.Class. However, when dealing with generic types, this method can return a ParameterizedTypeImpl, which is not a subclass of Class. The code fails to handle this type, leading to a runtime crash when it attempts to cast the result directly to Class.
